A.  PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(s)

1.  Recommendation to hold a Public Hearing and conduct the second reading, by title only, of
  Ordinance No. 2025­621, amending Title 15 of the Hawaiian Gardens Municipal Code, adopting
  by reference the 2025 California Building, Electrical, Mechanical, Plumbing, and Residential
  Codes.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, introduced the item.

  Dennis Tarango, Transtech Engineers, presented the staff report.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Councilmember Roa, to approve
  recommendation and adopt Ordinance No. 2025­621.

  The motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; Farfan, Roa, Del Rio, De Paula
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 1; Vargas
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 4–0–1–0

B.  CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  WAIVE READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS ON THE AGENDA
  That the City Council waive reading in full of all ordinances and resolutions on the agenda and
  declare that said titles which appear on the public agenda shall be determined to have been read
  by title and further reading waived.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Councilmember Roa, to adopt the
  Consent Calendar Items 1­6, except for Item 2.

C. DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

1.  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. 033­2025, approving, authorizing, and directing
  execution of a Joint Exercise of Powers Agreement with the California Municipal Finance Authority.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, introduced the item.

  Travis Cooper, California Municipal Finance Authority, spoke.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio, to approve
  recommendation and adopt Resolution No. 033­2025.

  The motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; Farfan, Roa, Del Rio, De Paula
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 1; Vargas
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 4–0–1–0

2.  Recommendation to review and approve the amended guidelines for the City’s Youth and Adult
  Scholarship Program.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, presented the staff report.

  Councilmember Roa spoke.

  Mayor De Paula spoke.

  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, spoke.

  Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio spoke.

  Councilmember Farfan spoke.

  A motion was made by Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio, seconded by Councilmember Farfan, to approve
  recommendation, as amended, for the guidelines to include a 10­hour Community Service
  requirement, whether it’s done at the city or elsewhere.

  The motion carried by the following vote:

D.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced the dates for upcoming events:
Turkey Giveaway Drive, November 22; Tree Lighting Event, December 5; Breakfast with Santa,
December 6; Youth Volleyball Tournament, December 7; Flag Football Tournament, December 13­14;
and have begun renovation at C. Robert Lee Activity Center.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, provided a street sweeping schedule and ongoing Public
Works Projects updates due to forecasted rain; and announced that the Carson Street Beautification
Project Phase 2, has been selected as one of the American Public Works Association APWA Southern
California Chapter best award winners in the traffic mobility and beautification category.

Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, announced a ribbon­cutting ceremony for Sushi
Forest on November 13.

Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, provided an update on the fee study, and ERP system.

Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, announced that the city has partnered with LA Food Bank and
